seo_title: UBORA CAPITAL PARTNER — Investing in healthcare in Central Africa
seo_description: Investment holding company specialising in healthcare in Central Africa. We invest in, support and develop pharmacies, laboratories, health centres and private clinics.

body.title: Building the future of healthcare in Central Africa
body.subtitle: We invest in, support and develop the healthcare facilities shaping tomorrow's access to care.
body.text: UBORA CAPITAL PARTNER is an investment holding company specialising in the healthcare sector in Central Africa. Based between Germany and Cameroon, we support pharmacies, medical laboratories, family health centres and private clinics through their succession, modernisation and growth.
body.missions:
Preserve strategic healthcare facilities
Support their professionalisation
Finance their development
Build an integrated network of community healthcare

body.title: A strong vision for a sector in full transformation
body.text:
Central Africa is experiencing rapid population growth, sustained urbanisation and rising demand for quality healthcare infrastructure. At the same time, many healthcare facilities remain underfunded, insufficiently structured or face succession challenges.
At UBORA CAPITAL PARTNER, we believe that improving access to quality care is both a social imperative and one of the region's greatest economic opportunities for the decades ahead.

body.title: A high-potential but highly fragmented market
body.intro: Every day, many healthcare providers have to deal with:

lists.items:
Limited access to financing
Insufficiently formalised governance
Management and oversight difficulties
Lack of investment in equipment
Weak administrative and financial structure
Succession and business transfer issues

body.outro: This holds back their development, even though they play an essential role in giving people access to care.

body.title: The succession of healthcare businesses
body.intro:
Many pharmacies, medical practices, laboratories and clinics founded several decades ago are now reaching a decisive stage in their history.
Founders wish to hand over their business, while their heirs do not always have the will or the means to ensure its continuity.

lists.title: UBORA CAPITAL PARTNER offers a responsible takeover solution that ensures:
lists.items:
Business continuity
Job preservation
Protection of know-how
Continued access to care for local communities

body.title: We invest in four key segments

cards.title: Retail pharmacies
cards.text: We support pharmacies with a strategic location and strong potential for modernisation, expansion or consolidation.

cards.title: Medical laboratories
cards.text: We back facilities that meet the growing demand for reliable, modern and accessible diagnostics.

cards.title: Family health centres
cards.text: We invest in community facilities facing financing, structuring or succession needs.

cards.title: Private clinics
cards.text: We provide the financial and operational resources needed to accelerate their development and strengthen their governance.

body.title: Investor-operator
body.intro: Unlike a purely financial investor, we are directly involved in creating value in the companies we support.

steps.title: Capital contribution
steps.items:
Acquisitions and takeovers of facilities
The opening of new sites
Infrastructure modernisation
The purchase of medical equipment
Working capital reinforcement
External growth projects

steps.title: Operational support
steps.items:
Improve their governance
Structure their financial management
Implement management tools
Optimise their operating processes
Professionalise their teams
Strengthen their regulatory compliance
Prepare for access to bank financing

body.conclusion: To turn under-exploited assets into high-performing, profitable and bankable companies.

body.title: Building the first integrated network of community healthcare

lists.title: We are gradually developing an ecosystem made up of:
lists.items:
Pharmacies
Medical laboratories
Health centres
Private clinics

lists.title: This strategy enables:
lists.items:
Better pooling of resources
Cost optimisation
Continuous improvement in the quality of care
Stronger profitability
Greater appeal to institutional investors

body.title: A presence between Europe and Africa
body.intro: Our presence in both Germany and Cameroon allows us to combine international expertise with a thorough understanding of local realities.

cards.title: Sector expertise
cards.text: An exclusive focus on the healthcare sector.

cards.title: Field experience
cards.text: A hands-on understanding of the challenges faced by healthcare SMEs.

cards.title: International network
cards.text: Access to European partners, experts and investors.

cards.title: Long-term vision
cards.text: We favour sustainable value creation over short-term results.

body.title: Our ambition
body.text:
We aim to become one of the leading consolidators of the healthcare sector in Central Africa by building a portfolio of complementary, profitable facilities with a strong social impact.
Through investment, succession, professionalisation and the development of healthcare businesses, we help to strengthen access to care in a lasting way, while creating value for entrepreneurs, investors and communities.
